action.backup_management.description: View or regenerate own backup codes with current fresh session and locked password recheck

errors.refused: Opaque invalid_credentials, invalid_control, connection_refused and trusted crypto/clock/config errors; all failures are NotCommitted or OutcomeUnknown with explicit handle reuse; no committed Rejected result is returned by management

preconditions: Caller owns admitted control/workspace lifetime; runtime supplies trusted keyring/signer/Clock/audit configuration
User has current fresh session and verified email/enabled verified MFA factor with active access
postconditions: Codes leave only after current identity/password recheck and known pool/audit commit
Management preserves sessions/TOTP/failure budget and refuses unsupported old pools
external_effects: Current factor backupCodes replacement for regeneration and canonical append-only workspace_audit management event with subject/session/version tuple

authorization.rationale: Current fresh session/credential/access and serialized current pool/audit must be rechecked before disclosure; concurrent login may consume codes. Regeneration is not idempotent and unknown commit requires reconciliation without automatic replay.
